entry.author: Inland Revenue NZ
entry.summary:
Tax is vital to New Zealand life, but can be complicated. Take a look at these examples with Ivy and Rikki to find out what you need to do at the end of the tax year. You'll find out what you'll receive and when, based on the situation that best fits you. 

You can find out more, here: 
https://www.ird.govt.nz/end-of-tax-year

----------------------------------------------------------------

Follow us on social media for help with general queries relating to any of Inland Revenue's products and services: 

Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/IRDNZ/
LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/company/inland-revenue-nz/

Stay up-to-date: https://www.ird.govt.nz/
